name: PSSHI_FBR_LC
rationale: The previous design (PSSHI_FBR_Zener) failed due to a conflict between ripple and settling time: a large Cout reduced ripple but caused the output mean to drift (long RC time constant), while a small Cout improved settling but increased ripple. To decouple these, I am introducing an LC filter at the output of the rectifier. The inductor (L2) smooths the charging current pulses from the FBR, allowing for a smaller Cout that satisfies the settling time (dv) and startup (tup) constraints while maintaining low peak-to-peak ripple (vpp).
